ext_name.description: Manifest name and the settings heading. The brand: keep "Tag Kit" as is and translate only "for". At most 75 characters (Chrome limit).

ext_short_name.description: Manifest short_name, where space is tight. The brand, kept as is. At most 12 characters (Chrome recommendation).

ext_description.message: Etiqueta juegos con lo que informa Steam: aviso de IA, antitrampas, DRM, Steam Deck, Préstamo familiar y más. No recopila nada.
ext_description.description: Manifest description and userscript @description. At most 132 characters (Chrome limit). Name each tag as Steam's own store in that language does.

ext_action_title.message: Configuración de Tag Kit para Steam
ext_action_title.description: Tooltip of the extension's toolbar button, which opens the settings popup. At most 75 characters. Keep "Tag Kit for Steam" as in ext_name.

error_unexpected.description: Logged to the browser console when something fails without a more specific message. Short; developers read it, not players.

warn_breaker_opened.message: Steam rechazó una petición; la detección se pausará durante $seconds$ segundos ($breaker$).
warn_breaker_opened.description: Logged to the browser console when the extension stops asking Steam for a while after an error answer, to avoid being rate-limited. $breaker$ is an internal storage key such as v1:breaker; keep it as is.

notice_breaker_closed.message: La pausa terminó, la detección será reanudada ($breaker$).
notice_breaker_closed.description: Logged to the browser console when the pause after an error answer from Steam is over. $breaker$ is an internal storage key such as v1:breaker; keep it as is.

error_breaker_store.message: No se pudo leer ni guardar la pausa tras una petición rechazada ($breaker$); esta pestaña mantiene la suya hasta que el almacenamiento vuelva a funcionar.
error_breaker_store.description: Logged to the browser console once when the browser storage that shares the pause after an error answer from Steam fails, until it works again. $breaker$ is an internal storage key such as v1:breaker; keep it as is.

notice_page_disagrees.message: La página de la tienda dice $page$ y los datos de Steam dicen $data$ para la etiqueta $kind$ de la aplicación $app$.
notice_page_disagrees.description: Logged to the browser console in debug mode when the open game's page and the data Steam returns for it give different answers for one tag. $kind$ is the tag id and $page$ and $data$ are verdict states; keep them as they are.

kind_ai_heading.message: Información sobre contenido generado por IA
kind_ai_heading.description: Steam's own heading of the block where a developer describes generative AI use. It titles the AI entry in the hover card, follows the chip text in the AI chip's screen reader name and heads the notice on the game's page. Use the wording Steam shows in this language.

kind_ai_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_ai_chip.description: Short chip for a game whose developer filled in Steam's AI disclosure. Keep it to a few characters; it sits in a row and over game images.

kind_kernel_heading.message: Utiliza antitrampas a nivel de kernel
kind_kernel_heading.description: Steam's own line for a game whose anti-cheat runs at kernel level. It titles the entry in the hover card and follows the chip text in the chip's screen reader name. Use the wording Steam shows in this language.

kind_kernel_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_kernel_chip.description: Short chip for a game with kernel level anti-cheat. Keep it short; it sits in a row and over game images.

kind_kernel_uninstall.message: Debe eliminarse a mano después de desinstalar el juego
kind_kernel_uninstall.description: Steam's own note in the hover card when a kernel level anti-cheat stays on the computer after the game is uninstalled.

kind_kernel_boot.message: Protección de arranque - Requiere tanto arranque seguro como TPM 2.0
kind_kernel_boot.description: Steam's own note in the hover card when the game needs boot protection. Use the wording Steam shows in this language; keep the hyphen between the two parts.

kind_anticheat_heading.description: Steam's own line for a game with anti-cheat software that does not run at kernel level. It titles the entry in the hover card and follows the chip text in the chip's screen reader name. Use the wording Steam shows in this language.

kind_anticheat_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_anticheat_chip.description: Short chip for a game with anti-cheat software. Keep it short; it sits in a row and over game images.

kind_drm_heading.description: Steam's own line for a game whose developer declared third-party DRM. It titles the entry in the hover card and follows the chip text in the chip's screen reader name; the DRM the developer named follows in the card, untranslated.

kind_drm_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_drm_chip.description: Short chip for a game with third-party DRM. Keep it short; it sits in a row and over game images.

kind_account_heading.description: Steam's own line for a game that needs an account with another company. It titles the entry in the hover card and follows the chip text in the chip's screen reader name; the account the developer named follows in the card, untranslated.

kind_account_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_account_chip.description: Short chip for a game that requires a third-party account. Keep it short; it sits in a row and over game images.

kind_account_links.message: (permite la vinculación a una cuenta de Steam)
kind_account_links.description: Steam's own note in the hover card, under the third-party account, when that account can be linked to the player's Steam account.

kind_eula_heading.message: Es necesario aceptar un ALUF de terceros
kind_eula_heading.description: Steam's own line for a game that makes the player accept an end user license agreement of another company. It titles the entry in the hover card and follows the chip text in the chip's screen reader name; the agreement names follow in the card, untranslated.

kind_eula_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_eula_chip.description: Short chip for a game with a third-party end user license agreement. Use the abbreviation Steam uses in this language; it sits in a row and over game images.

kind_pvp_heading.description: Title of the PvP entry in the hover card and, after the chip text, the chip's screen reader name (said once when the two match). Use the abbreviation Steam uses in this language for player versus player.

kind_pvp_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_pvp_description.message: JcJ en línea, en LAN o a pantalla dividida
kind_pvp_description.description: Second, quieter line under the tag's short name on its settings tab and its Tag order row. It describes the tag, never a game, and must differ from the short name. Steam's three PvP category names, joined. Use the category names Steam shows in this language.

kind_pvp_chip.description: Short chip for a game with a player versus player mode, as its Steam categories say. Use the abbreviation Steam uses in this language.

kind_pvp_category_pvp.description: Steam's category name for player versus player, listed in the hover card.

kind_pvp_category_online.description: Steam's category name for online player versus player, listed in the hover card.

kind_pvp_category_lan.description: Steam's category name for player versus player over a local network, listed in the hover card.

kind_pvp_category_split.description: Steam's category name for player versus player on one shared or split screen, listed in the hover card.

kind_iap_heading.description: Steam's category name for a game that sells items inside it. It titles the entry in the hover card and the banner, names the settings section and follows the chip text in the chip's screen reader name. Use the name Steam's store shows for this category in this language. Unverified: compare with the features list of a game with in-app purchases on the Spanish store page (/app/730/?l=spanish) and correct it and the chip to Steam's words.

kind_iap_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_iap_description.message: Contiene compras dentro de la aplicación
kind_iap_description.description: Second, quieter line under the tag's short name on its settings tab and its Tag order row. It describes the tag, never a game, and must differ from the short name. Steam's category name inside a plain line. Use the category name Steam shows in this language.

kind_iap_chip.description: Short chip for a game with in-app purchases, as its Steam categories say. Keep it short; it sits in a row and over game images. Unverified like the heading: a short form of Steam's category name.

kind_deck_heading.description: Steam's own heading of the Steam Deck rating Valve gives a game. It titles the entry in the hover card, names the settings section with the rating word heads the entry in the notice on the game's page, and it follows the chip text in the chip's screen reader name. Use the wording Steam shows in this language. From Steam's Spanish client strings; not checked on a live store page.

kind_deck_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_deck_chip.description: Short device word at the start of a Steam Deck chip, followed by Steam's rating word (kind_facet_chip): "Deck: No compatible". Our short form of the device name, for chips only; keep it short.

kind_machine_heading.description: Steam's own heading of the Steam Machine rating Valve gives a game. It titles the entry in the hover card, names the settings section with the rating word heads the entry in the notice on the game's page, and it follows the chip text in the chip's screen reader name. Use the wording Steam shows in this language. From Steam's Spanish client strings; not checked on a live store page.

kind_machine_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_machine_chip.description: Device word at the start of a Steam Machine chip, followed by Steam's rating word (kind_facet_chip): "Steam Machine: No compatible". The device name, which Steam has no short form for.

kind_compat_verified.description: Steam's word for the best Steam Deck and Steam Machine rating, shown under the heading in the hover card, after the device word on the chip and as a choice in the settings. Use the word Steam shows in this language. Steam shares the rating words between Steam Deck and Steam Machine; the Machine section was not checked live in this language.

kind_compat_playable.description: Steam's word for the middle Steam Deck and Steam Machine rating: the game works, with some effort. Shown like Verified. Use the word Steam shows in this language. Steam shares the rating words between Steam Deck and Steam Machine; the Machine section was not checked live in this language.

kind_compat_unsupported.description: Steam's word for a game Valve rated as not working on Steam Deck or Steam Machine. Shown like Verified. Use the word Steam shows in this language. Never use it for a game Valve has not rated. Steam shares the rating words between Steam Deck and Steam Machine; the Machine section was not checked live in this language.

kind_family_heading.description: Steam's own name of Family Sharing, the Steam feature that lets a family share a library. It titles the entry in the hover card, names the settings section, follows the chip text in the chip's screen reader name and is the choice for a game Steam lists it for. It is also the listed value's chip text, in full; the compact badge may cut it with an ellipsis when narrow. Use the word Steam shows in this language. From Steam's Spanish client strings; not checked on a live store page.

kind_family_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_family_description.message: Compatibilidad con el préstamo familiar de Steam
kind_family_description.description: Second, quieter line under the tag's short name on its settings tab and its Tag order row. It describes the tag, never a game, and must differ from the short name. Steam's feature name inside a plain line: whether Steam lists Family Sharing.

kind_family_unsupported.description: Steam's own words for a game that cannot be shared in a family library. The heading of the entry in the notice on the game's page, a choice in the settings, the package summary's name for the value and, after the chip text, the screen reader name of its chip, for a paid game whose Steam feature list leaves Family Sharing out. Keep Steam's wording and capitalization in this language. From Steam's Spanish client strings; not checked on a live store page.

kind_family_unsupported_chip.description: Chip for a paid game whose Steam feature list leaves Family Sharing out. Our own short words, chosen by the maintainer; the chip's screen reader name gives Steam's words ("Family Sharing not Available") after it. Keep it short, it sits in a row and over game images; the compact badge may cut it with an ellipsis when narrow. Use this kind of wording only for this key and the hover card line of this value. Unverified: our own Spain Spanish, not checked against Steam's wording.

kind_family_unsupported_line.message: El préstamo familiar no está disponible para este juego
kind_family_unsupported_line.description: In the hover card, under the heading "Family Sharing", for a paid game whose Steam feature list leaves Family Sharing out. Our own sentence; the card always closes with the line that says it comes from the features Steam lists for the game. Keep it a plain statement and say nothing about why. Unverified: our own Spain Spanish, not checked against Steam's wording.

kind_earlyaccess_heading.description: Steam's own line for a game in Early Access, the heading of the notice at the top of its store page. It titles the entry in the hover card, names the settings section and begins the screen reader name of the chip. Use the line Steam's store shows in this language. Unverified: not checked against Steam's Spanish store.

kind_earlyaccess_key.description: Short name of the tag in the settings, where people look for it: the tab label, the row in the Tag order card and the row in the toolbar popup. Our own word, never a claim about a game; Steam's full line follows it for screen readers. Normal capitalization.

kind_earlyaccess_description.message: Este juego todavía está en acceso anticipado
kind_earlyaccess_description.description: Second, quieter line under the tag's short name on its settings tab and its Tag order row. It describes the tag, never a game, and must differ from the short name. Plain line on what the tag marks, with Steam's program name.

kind_earlyaccess_chip.description: Short chip for a game in Early Access, as Steam's own tag and filter call it. Keep it short; it sits in a row and over game images.

kind_earlyaccess_released.description: In the hover card, under the heading for a game in Early Access: the release date the store page lists, Steam's own label. $date$ is a date formatted for the language.

kind_earlyaccess_updated.description: In the hover card on a game's own store page, under the heading for a game in Early Access: the date of the developer's latest post of the update type in the community hub. It says nothing about builds, so keep it about the post. $date$ is a date formatted for the language.

kind_chip_name.description: Screen reader name of a chip, a settings tab or a popup row: the visible text, then Steam's full line for the kind, or Steam's word for a value that names the kind by itself. $chip$ is the chip text (the person's own when they set one) or the tag's short name, and $heading$ Steam's words.

kind_facet_chip.description: Visible text of a chip for a tag with values, such as "Deck: No compatible": the tag's short word, then Steam's word for the value. The colon keeps the two from reading as one phrase.

kind_facet_name.description: Steam's heading of a tag with values, then Steam's word for the value: the heading of its entry in the notice on a game's page and its line in a package's summary.

kind_chip_more.description: Chip that stands for the kinds that do not fit beside the other chips. $count$ is how many kinds it stands for.

kind_chip_more_name.description: After the chip text, names the hidden chips for screen readers, as in "+2: more tags".

kind_full_game.description: In the hover card and in the notice on a demo's store page, right under a tag's heading when the tag is shown because the full game declared it; the demo did not declare it itself. "The full game" is the product the demo belongs to. Never say the demo declared it.

kind_full_game_valve.description: In the hover card and in the notice on a demo's store page, right under the heading of a fact Valve states (a Steam Deck or Steam Machine rating, Family Sharing) when it is shown because Valve states it for the full game; Valve says nothing about the demo itself. Never say the demo was rated or listed.

badge_card_declared.message: Declarado por el desarrollador en la página de la tienda
badge_card_declared.description: Last line of the hover card. It says the developer, not this extension, made the declarations above.

badge_card_valve.description: Last line of the hover card when it lists a fact Valve states, such as a Steam Deck rating. It says Valve, not this extension or the developer, is the source of those entries. With entries of both kinds it follows the line that names the developer.

kind_family_source.message: Según las características que Steam indica para este juego
kind_family_source.description: Last line of the hover card when it lists Family Sharing, instead of "According to Valve". It says the entry comes from the feature list Steam shows for the game, which Valve computes. With entries of other kinds it follows their source lines. Unverified: our own Spain Spanish, not checked against Steam's wording.

badge_card_service_label.message: Servicios de IA que cita el desarrollador:
badge_card_service_label.description: In that panel, precedes a product name inserted as data, untranslated.

badge_card_more.message: El texto completo está en la página del juego.
badge_card_more.description: In that panel, shown when it cuts a long developer text short.

badge_tags_title.message: Etiquetas de Tag Kit para este producto
badge_tags_title.description: Small label above the chips this extension adds to a game's own store page, right under Steam's "Popular user-defined tags for this product:" block, and above the Tag Kit summary at the top of a package page. It names the chips as ours, apart from the players' tags. Keep "Tag Kit" as is. No colon.

badge_summary_games_one.description: A line of the Tag Kit summary at the top of a package page, one per tag. $kind$ is Steam's own line for the tag, $count$ is how many of the package's games have a known answer for it and $tagged$ how many of those carry the tag. Neutral count words only: never say that the other games are free of it. Singular form, chosen by $count$.

badge_summary_games_other.description: A line of the Tag Kit summary at the top of a package page, one per tag. $kind$ is Steam's own line for the tag, $count$ is how many of the package's games have a known answer for it and $tagged$ how many of those carry the tag. Neutral count words only: never say that the other games are free of it. Plural form, chosen by $count$.

badge_summary_pending_one.description: A line at the end of the same summary while some of the package's games are still being looked up. $count$ is how many. Singular form.

badge_summary_pending_other.description: A line at the end of the same summary while some of the package's games are still being looked up. $count$ is how many. Plural form.

banner_source.description: In the notice on a game's store page, introduces the developer's text, which follows untranslated.

banner_region_label.description: Screen reader name of the notice on a game's page when it lists more than one kind, or only notes about ignored kinds, and every kind it lists comes from the developer.

banner_expand.description: Expands the collapsed text of the notice.

banner_collapse.description: Collapses the text of the notice again.

banner_ignore.description: Title of the first option in the ignore menu, under no heading, that stops every tag and this notice for one game, in this extension only. The store has its own Ignore button; this one does not touch it. Also names the action in announcements.

banner_menu_ignore.description: Main half of the split button at the foot of the notice. It ignores every tag on this game and its DLC, in this extension only; Steam's own Ignore list is not touched. Hovering or clicking the arrow beside it opens the ignore menu.

banner_menu_ignored.message: Dejar de ignorar etiquetas para este juego
banner_menu_ignored.description: The same button once the game is ignored for every tag, after a tick. It names what pressing it does: stop ignoring the game for every tag.

banner_menu_label.description: Accessible name of the arrow beside the Ignore button, which opens the ignore menu. Worded like the alt text of Steam's own arrow.

banner_menu_group_developers.description: Heading of the ignore menu's group that lists the game's developers, each with options that ignore it.

banner_menu_group_publishers.description: Heading of the ignore menu's group that lists the game's publishers, each with options that ignore it.

banner_menu_group_tags.description: Heading of the ignore menu's group with one option per tag this extension shows for the game. These are the extension's tags, not Steam's user tags.

banner_menu_game_note.message: Todas las etiquetas de este juego y su contenido descargable
banner_menu_game_note.description: Muted line under "Ignore this game" in the ignore menu: what the option covers.

banner_menu_all_tags.description: Title of the option under a developer's or publisher's name in the ignore menu that ignores it for every tag.

banner_menu_developer_all_note.message: En todos los juegos que desarrolla
banner_menu_developer_all_note.description: Muted line under "All tags" for a developer in the ignore menu.

banner_menu_publisher_all_note.message: En todos los juegos que distribuye
banner_menu_publisher_all_note.description: Muted line under "All tags" for a publisher in the ignore menu.

banner_ignored.description: Note on the notice while the game is ignored for every tag. Unchecking the option in the ignore menu undoes it.

banner_ignored_kind.description: Note on the notice while the game is ignored for one tag, in place of that tag's entry. $heading$ is Steam's line for the kind. Unchecking the tag in the ignore menu undoes it.

heading.example: Utiliza antitrampas a nivel de kernel

banner_ignored_creator.description: Note on the notice once a developer or publisher is ignored for every tag. $name$ is the name Steam shows, untranslated, and $role$ is developer or publisher.

banner_ignored_creator_kind.description: Note on the notice once a developer or publisher is ignored for one tag. $name$ is the name Steam shows, untranslated, $role$ is developer or publisher and $heading$ is Steam's line for the tag.

notice_creator_stopped.description: Screen reader announcement after ignoring a developer or publisher for every tag. $name$ is the name Steam shows, untranslated, and $role$ is developer or publisher.

notice_creator_stopped_kind.message: Se ignorarán los juegos de $name$ ($role$) para $heading$
notice_creator_stopped_kind.description: Screen reader announcement after ignoring a developer or publisher for one tag. $name$ is the name Steam shows, untranslated, $role$ is developer or publisher and $heading$ is Steam's line for the tag.

notice_list_hidden_one.message: Tag Kit ha ocultado $count$ título según tu configuración.
notice_list_hidden_one.description: A bar above search results, styled like Steam's own notice there, when a tag's list filter is set to Hide and it removed some results from this list. Worded like that notice ("2 titles have been excluded based on your preferences."); follow the words Steam uses for it in your language. $count$ is the number of results it hid. It names only the number: never which tags, and never that a game uses AI. Singular form.

notice_list_hidden_other.message: Tag Kit ha ocultado $count$ títulos según tu configuración.
notice_list_hidden_other.description: A bar above search results, styled like Steam's own notice there, when a tag's list filter is set to Hide and it removed some results from this list. Worded like that notice ("2 titles have been excluded based on your preferences."); follow the words Steam uses for it in your language. $count$ is the number of results it hid. It names only the number: never which tags, and never that a game uses AI. Plural form.

notice_list_revealed_one.description: Replaces notice_list_hidden after the person clicked notice_list_show: the same results show again, dimmed, on this page only. $count$ is the number of those results. Singular form.

notice_list_revealed_other.description: Replaces notice_list_hidden after the person clicked notice_list_show: the same results show again, dimmed, on this page only. $count$ is the number of those results. Plural form.

notice_list_show_one.description: Button after notice_list_hidden. Shows the hidden results on this page only; the settings stay as they are. "it" or "them" refers to the results. Singular form.

notice_list_show_other.description: Button after notice_list_hidden. Shows the hidden results on this page only; the settings stay as they are. "it" or "them" refers to the results. Plural form.

notice_list_hide_one.description: Button after notice_list_revealed. Hides those results again. Singular form.

notice_list_hide_other.description: Button after notice_list_revealed. Hides those results again. Plural form.

notice_marking_stopped.description: Screen reader announcement after "Ignore this game".

notice_marking_stopped_kind.description: Screen reader announcement after a tag is checked for this game in the ignore menu. $heading$ is Steam's line for the tag.

heading.example: Utiliza antitrampas a nivel de kernel

notice_marking_restored.message: Este juego ya no será ignorado
notice_marking_restored.description: Screen reader announcement after unchecking it in the ignore menu or "Stop ignoring".

notice_marking_restored_kind.message: Este juego ya no será ignorado para $heading$
notice_marking_restored_kind.description: Screen reader announcement after unchecking it in the ignore menu or "Stop ignoring" for one tag. $heading$ is Steam's line for the tag.

heading.example: Utiliza antitrampas a nivel de kernel

notice_settings_saved.description: Screen reader announcement after a setting changes.

error_settings_save.message: No se pudo guardar este cambio. Inténtalo de nuevo.
error_settings_save.description: Under a setting whose change failed to save.

error_settings_load.message: No se pudo cargar tu configuración. Se muestran los valores por defecto.
error_settings_load.description: Top of the settings page when stored settings cannot be read.

error_allow_list_save.message: No se pudo actualizar este juego. Inténtalo de nuevo.
error_allow_list_save.description: After "Ignore this game", unchecking it in the ignore menu or "Stop ignoring" fails to save.

error_allow_list_load.message: No se pudieron cargar los juegos que ignoraste. Inténtalo más tarde.
error_allow_list_load.description: Shown in the list of ignored games in the settings when the stored list cannot be read.

options_version.description: Under the product name at the top of the settings page and popup. $version$ is the release version, such as 2026.10.20; keep it as is.

options_badges.description: Switch label of one tag's badge.

options_badges_short.description: The same switch in the toolbar popup, where space is tight.

options_badges_help.message: Añade «$label$» a los resultados de búsqueda, a la lista de deseados y a las imágenes de los juegos.
options_badges_help.description: Help under the badges switch. $label$ is the badge label.

options_banner.message: Entrada en el aviso de las páginas de juegos
options_banner.description: Switch label of one tag's entry in the notice on a game's page.

options_banner_help.message: Muestra la entrada de esta etiqueta encima del botón de compra.

options_filter_label.description: Label of a three-way choice: show, dim or hide these games in lists.

options_facets_label.description: Label of a group of checkboxes in a tag's settings, one per value Steam gives (Verificado, Jugable, No compatible; Préstamo familiar, Préstamo familiar no disponible). Only the ticked values get the tag.

options_facet_available.description: Checkbox label in Family Sharing's settings for the value Steam lists the feature for. Settings only: the chip, its screen reader name and the hover card keep Steam's own words.

options_facet_unavailable.description: Checkbox label in Family Sharing's settings for a paid game whose Steam feature list leaves Family Sharing out. Settings only: the chip, its screen reader name and the hover card keep Steam's own words.

options_facet_choice_label.description: Screen reader name of a checkbox in a tag's "Values to tag" group: the visible choice, then Steam's line for the tag, so a list of form controls names the tag. $choice$ is the checkbox text and $heading$ Steam's line for the tag.

options_facets_help.message: Los marcadores, las entradas del aviso y el filtro de listas actúan sobre los valores marcados aquí. Si no marcas ninguno, la etiqueta no marca ningún juego.

options_facet_label.description: Label of a group of radio buttons in the settings of Steam Deck and Steam Machine Compatibility, one per rating Steam gives (Verified, Playable, Unsupported). A game has one rating, so only one can be chosen, and only that one gets the tag.

options_facet_help.message: Los marcadores, las entradas del aviso y el filtro de listas actúan sobre el valor elegido aquí.

options_filter_off.description: Leave these games as they are.

options_filter_off_help.message: Las listas no cambian, excepto por los marcadores.

options_filter_dim_help.message: Atenúa estos juegos en las listas. Pasa el cursor por encima de uno para verlo normalmente.

options_filter_hide_help.message: Quita estos juegos de las listas. Si ocultarlos rompiese una lista, entonces se atenuarán.

options_color_label.description: Label of a text field where the person types a hex color for one tag, and the title of the color help in the General tab. It colors the tag's badge, its entry in the banner and its hover card, so use the same word as the badge switch. "(experimental)" marks the setting as unfinished; keep it in the label.

options_color_placeholder.description: Shown inside the empty color field: no custom color is set, so the tag keeps the extension's default violet. One word.

options_color_help.message: En la pestaña de una etiqueta, elige un color con el cuadrado o escribe un código hexadecimal como #8f73f3, con o sin la #. Da color al marcador de esa etiqueta, a su entrada en el aviso y a su tarjeta. No se comprueba el contraste, así que un color muy claro o muy oscuro puede ser difícil de leer. Déjalo vacío para usar el violeta predeterminado.
options_color_help.description: Help on colors, once in the General settings tab under the color title. The square opens the browser's own color picker. Keep the example code as it is. It must say that contrast is not checked.

options_color_invalid.message: No es un color. Escribe tres o seis dígitos hexadecimales, como #8f73f3.
options_color_invalid.description: Error under the color field while the text is not a hex color. Keep the example code as it is.

options_color_reset.description: Quiet button that clears one custom setting of a tag, its color or a chip text, and goes back to the default. One word.

options_color_reset_label.message: Restablecer el color del marcador (experimental) de $heading$
options_color_reset_label.description: Screen reader name of the Reset button next to a color field. Starts with the button's visible word. $heading$ is Steam's own line for the tag.

heading.example: Utiliza antitrampas a nivel de kernel

options_color_pick_label.message: Elegir el color del marcador de $heading$
options_color_pick_label.description: Screen reader name of the color square next to the hex field; clicking it opens the browser's own color picker. $heading$ is Steam's own line for the tag.

heading.example: Utiliza antitrampas a nivel de kernel

options_chip_label.description: Label of a text field in one tag's settings where the person types their own words for the tag's chip, the short label on badges and in the tag list of a game's page. Empty keeps the extension's own words, shown as the placeholder.

options_chip_help.message: Tus propias palabras para los marcadores de esta etiqueta y sus botones de Ignorar. Déjalo vacío para usar el texto predeterminado. Las tarjetas, los títulos del aviso y los lectores de pantalla siguen dando las palabras de Steam.
options_chip_help.description: Help under the chip text field. Says where the person's words show, that empty means the default, and that the hover card, the banner's headings and screen readers keep Steam's own words after them.

options_chip_compact_label.description: Label of a second, shorter text field for the chip shown on narrow game images (180 to 399 pixels wide). Empty uses the chip text above, then the extension's own words.

options_chip_compact_help.message: Se muestra en las imágenes de juegos de menos de 400 píxeles de ancho. Déjalo vacío para usar el texto del marcador.
options_chip_compact_help.description: Help under the short chip text field. "Chip text" names the field above it (options_chip_label).

options_chip_count.description: Counter under a chip text field: how many characters the field holds and the most it takes, as numbers, such as "5 of 32".

options_chip_reset_label.message: Restablecer el texto del marcador de $heading$
options_chip_reset_label.description: Screen reader name of the Reset button next to the chip text field. Starts with the button's visible word (options_color_reset). $heading$ is Steam's own line for the tag.

heading.example: Utiliza antitrampas a nivel de kernel

options_chip_compact_reset_label.description: Screen reader name of the Reset button next to the short chip text field. Starts with the button's visible word (options_color_reset). $heading$ is Steam's own line for the tag.

heading.example: Utiliza antitrampas a nivel de kernel

options_chip_preview.description: Label above a live preview of the tag's chips as typed: the badge on rows, then the chip on a small game image. One or two words.

options_language_auto.description: First entry of the language picker.

options_language_help.message: Usa el idioma de la tienda si hay traducción; inglés si no.

options_section_allow.description: Caption of the games in a card of ignored items, and the name of that list in a backup.

options_allow_since.description: Under a game you ignored. $date$ is already formatted for the locale.

options_allow_scope_all.description: Heading of the games ignored for every tag, in the list of ignored games. The games ignored for one tag sit under Steam's line for that tag.

options_allow_restore.description: Button next to a game you ignored.

options_allow_restore_label.description: Screen reader name of the "Stop ignoring" button; $name$ is the game's name, untranslated, and $scope$ names the tag it was ignored for, or all tags.

options_allow_empty.message: Ninguno aún. Usa el menú Ignorar en la página de un juego.
options_allow_empty.description: Shown in a card of ignored items for all tags when it lists nothing. The ignore menu opens from the arrow beside "Ignore tags for this game" at the foot of the notice on a game page.

options_section_allow_developers.description: Caption of the developers in a card of ignored items, and the name of that list in a backup.

options_section_allow_publishers.description: Caption of the publishers in a card of ignored items, and the name of that list in a backup.

error_creator_list_save.message: No se pudo actualizar este desarrollador o distribuidor. Inténtalo de nuevo.
error_creator_list_save.description: After "Stop ignoring" on a developer or publisher, or its ignore button on a game page, fails to save.

error_creator_list_load.message: No se pudieron cargar los desarrolladores y distribuidores que ignoraste. Inténtalo más tarde.
error_creator_list_load.description: Shown in the lists of ignored developers and publishers in the settings when a stored list cannot be read.

banner_role_developer.description: A game's developer as a role label: in parentheses after the name in sentences about it.

banner_role_publisher.description: A game's publisher as a role label: in parentheses after the name in sentences about it.

notice_creator_restored.description: Screen reader announcement after unchecking it in the ignore menu or "Stop ignoring" on a developer or publisher. $name$ is the name Steam shows, untranslated, and $role$ is developer or publisher.

notice_creator_restored_kind.description: Screen reader announcement after unchecking it in the ignore menu or "Stop ignoring" on a developer or publisher for one tag. $name$ is the name Steam shows, untranslated, $role$ is developer or publisher and $heading$ is Steam's line for the tag.

options_section_backup.description: Title of the settings card that saves the settings and ignore lists to a file and restores them. Full options page and userscript dialog only.

options_backup_help.message: Guarda tu configuración y tus listas de ignorados en un archivo de este dispositivo, o restáuralas desde uno. La extensión y el userscript leen el mismo archivo. No incluye los resultados de las consultas.
options_backup_help.description: Help under the Backup title. The file stays on the person's device; nothing is sent anywhere. "userscript" is the script version of the product. "Lookup results" are the cached answers about games, which are not in the file.

options_backup_download.description: Button that saves the settings and ignore lists to a JSON file through the browser's download.

options_backup_restore.description: Button that opens the file chooser to pick a backup file. Nothing changes until the person confirms with options_backup_confirm. Also the accessible name of the file chooser.

options_backup_summary_title.description: Title of the check shown after a valid backup file is picked, before anything changes. $date$ is the day the backup was made, formatted for the language.

options_backup_summary_list.description: One line of the check after a backup file is picked: a list in the file and how many entries it holds. $list$ is a settings card title such as "Games you ignored", $number$ a number.

options_backup_summary_skipped_one.message: $count$ entrada no se puede leer y se omitirá
options_backup_summary_skipped_one.description: Line of the check after a backup file is picked, when some ignore list entries in it are damaged. $count$ is how many. Singular form.

options_backup_summary_skipped_other.message: $count$ entradas no se pueden leer y se omitirán
options_backup_summary_skipped_other.description: Line of the check after a backup file is picked, when some ignore list entries in it are damaged. $count$ is how many. Plural form.

options_backup_restore_note.message: Restaurar reemplaza la configuración de aquí por la del archivo y añade sus elementos ignorados a tus listas. No se quita nada de lo que ignoraste aquí.
options_backup_restore_note.description: Note in the check before the person confirms a restore: what the restore will do.

options_backup_confirm.description: Primary button of the check: applies the picked backup file.

options_backup_cancel.description: Button of the check: closes it and changes nothing.

notice_backup_downloaded.description: Status line and screen reader announcement after the backup file was handed to the browser's download.

notice_backup_restored_one.message: Copia restaurada. Se añadió $count$ entrada nueva a tus listas de ignorados.
notice_backup_restored_one.description: Status line and screen reader announcement after a restore. $count$ is how many ignore list entries were not on this browser before. Singular form.

notice_backup_restored_other.message: Copia restaurada. Se añadieron $count$ entradas nuevas a tus listas de ignorados.
notice_backup_restored_other.description: Status line and screen reader announcement after a restore. $count$ is how many ignore list entries were not on this browser before. Plural form.

notice_backup_skipped_one.message: $count$ entrada no se pudo leer y se omitió.
notice_backup_skipped_one.description: Follows notice_backup_restored when some ignore list entries in the file were damaged. $count$ is how many. Singular form.

notice_backup_skipped_other.message: $count$ entradas no se pudieron leer y se omitieron.
notice_backup_skipped_other.description: Follows notice_backup_restored when some ignore list entries in the file were damaged. $count$ is how many. Plural form.

error_backup_invalid.message: $name$ no es una copia de Tag Kit, o es demasiado grande para serlo. No se cambió nada.
error_backup_invalid.description: Error after picking a file that is not a backup of this product. $name$ is the file name, shown as is. "Tag Kit" is the brand, kept as is.

error_backup_newer.message: $name$ viene de una versión más nueva de Tag Kit. Actualiza Tag Kit aquí y vuelve a intentarlo. No se cambió nada.
error_backup_newer.description: Error after picking a backup made by a later version of the product. $name$ is the file name, shown as is. "Tag Kit" is the brand, kept as is.

error_backup_read.message: No se pudo leer $name$. No se cambió nada.
error_backup_read.description: Error when the browser cannot read the picked file. $name$ is the file name, shown as is.

error_backup_create.message: No se pudo crear la copia. Inténtalo de nuevo.
error_backup_create.description: Error when "Download backup" fails because the settings or lists cannot be read or the browser refuses the download.

error_backup_restore.message: No se pudo restaurar toda la copia. Inténtalo de nuevo; restaurar el mismo archivo dos veces es seguro.
error_backup_restore.description: Error when saving a restore fails. A retry only adds what is missing, so it is safe.

options_privacy_no_reports.message: No envía informes sobre juegos ni usuarios. Solo lee lo que declaran los desarrolladores en Steam.
options_privacy_no_reports.description: Privacy bullet: the product never sends reports about games or users anywhere; it only shows what developers reported to Steam.

options_privacy_storage.message: La configuración y los resultados se quedan en tu navegador.

options_privacy_lookup.message: Para comprobar un juego, consulta los servidores de la propia tienda de Valve, sin tus cookies ni tu cuenta.

options_privacy_nothing_sent.message: Esta extensión no envía nada a nosotros ni a terceros. Nada de analíticas.

options_unaffiliated.message: Esta extensión no está afiliada a Valve Corporation ni cuenta con su respaldo. Steam es una marca comercial de Valve Corporation.
options_unaffiliated.description: Legal line at the bottom of the settings; keep the names as they are.

options_unaffiliated_short.message: Esta extensión no está afiliada a Valve. Ninguna información sale de tu navegador excepto peticiones a la tienda de Valve.

options_feedback_label.description: Accessible name of the group of three links at the bottom of the settings: report a bug, leave feedback, send anonymous feedback.

options_feedback_bug.description: Link at the bottom of the settings that opens the project's bug report form on GitHub in a new tab. Keep it short; an icon precedes it.

options_feedback_leave.description: Link at the bottom of the settings that opens the project's feedback form on GitHub in a new tab. Keep it short; an icon precedes it.

options_feedback_anonymous.message: Comentario o informe de error anónimo
options_feedback_anonymous.description: Link at the bottom of the settings that opens an anonymous feedback form in a new tab, with no GitHub account needed. An icon precedes it.

options_all_settings.description: Screen reader name and tooltip of the gear button at the top of the toolbar popup, which opens the full settings page in a tab.

options_back_to_steam.description: Button at the end of the settings page header. It switches back to the Steam store tab where the toolbar popup opened the settings and closes the settings tab; without such a tab it opens the Steam store home page in this tab.

options_kind_enabled.description: Master switch of one tag in the settings. Its section is titled with Steam's line for the tag.

options_kind_enabled_help.message: Si la desactivas, se quitan sus marcadores, su entrada en el aviso y su filtro de listas.
options_kind_enabled_help.description: Help under the master switch of one tag.

options_state_on.description: Short status on a tag's settings tab, after its name: the tag is switched on. It describes the tag's master switch, not any game.

options_state_off.description: Short status on a tag's settings tab, after its name: the tag is switched off. It describes the tag's master switch, not any game.

options_tabs_label.description: Screen reader name of the row of tabs at the top of the settings: General, then one tab per tag.

options_tab_general.description: The first settings tab and its heading: language, colors, what is ignored for all tags, backup and privacy. One word if the language allows.

options_tabs_group_tags.description: Small caption in the settings tab list, under General and a divider, over the tabs of the tags. Decoration only; screen readers skip it. One word.

options_allow_empty_kind.message: Ninguno aún. Usa el menú Ignorar en la página de un juego. Muestra esta etiqueta mientras su entrada en el aviso está activada.
options_allow_empty_kind.description: Shown in the card of games ignored for one tag when it lists nothing. The ignore menu on a game page lists a tag only while that tag's banner switch, on this same tab, is on.

options_allow_kind_title.description: Title of the card in a tag's settings tab that lists the games, developers and publishers ignored for that tag only.

options_allow_all_title.description: Title of the card in the General tab that lists the games, developers and publishers ignored for every tag.

options_allow_all_note_one.message: $count$ elemento ignorado para todas las etiquetas también cuenta aquí.
options_allow_all_note_one.description: Note in a tag's settings tab, under what is ignored for that tag: how many games, developers and publishers are ignored for every tag, which this tag follows too. $count$ is how many. Singular form.

options_allow_all_note_other.message: $count$ elementos ignorados para todas las etiquetas también cuentan aquí.
options_allow_all_note_other.description: The same note, plural form. $count$ is how many.

options_allow_all_show.description: Button after that note that opens the General tab at the list of what is ignored for all tags. "General" is the tab's name (options_tab_general).

options_order_title.description: Title of the card in the General settings tab where a person puts the tags in the order badges, banners and summaries list them.

options_order_help.message: Las etiquetas de arriba tienen prioridad: los marcadores, los avisos y los resúmenes las muestran en este orden y, donde falta espacio, las primeras lo ocupan. Las pestañas de la configuración y la ventana emergente siguen el mismo orden.
options_order_help.description: Help under the Tag order title. Tags higher in the list have priority: where a surface shows only a few tags, the first ones win the space. The tabs and the popup's rows follow the same order.

options_order_cut_one.message: En $surfaces$ solo cabe la primera etiqueta; el resto va en "+N".
options_order_cut_one.description: A dashed line in the Tag order card after the last tag some store surfaces show, and the same sentence for screen readers under the card's help. $surfaces$ names those surfaces, joined as a list ("game images and search suggestions"). $count$ is how many tags fit. "+N" is the chip that stands for the rest; keep it as is. Singular form.

options_order_cut_other.message: En $surfaces$ solo caben las $count$ primeras etiquetas; el resto va en "+N".
options_order_cut_other.description: A dashed line in the Tag order card after the last tag some store surfaces show, and the same sentence for screen readers under the card's help. $surfaces$ names those surfaces, joined as a list ("game images and search suggestions"). $count$ is how many tags fit. "+N" is the chip that stands for the rest; keep it as is. Plural form.

options_order_surface_images.description: Store surface named inside options_order_cut: the capsule images of games, large and small, where the tags sit over the image. Lower case unless the language needs otherwise; it sits inside a sentence.

options_order_surface_suggestions.description: Store surface named inside options_order_cut: the suggestions under the store's search box as a person types. Lower case; it sits inside a sentence.

options_order_surface_rows.message: las filas de búsqueda, de la lista de deseados y de DLC
options_order_surface_rows.description: Store surface named inside options_order_cut: the rows of the search results, the wishlist and the DLC list of a game's page, where the tags sit beside the title. Lower case; it sits inside a sentence.

options_order_how.message: Arrastra y suelta una etiqueta por su asa, o haz clic en el asa y luego en el asa del lugar al que va. Con el teclado, Espacio o Intro toma una etiqueta, las flechas la mueven, Espacio o Intro la suelta y Escape la devuelve a su sitio.
options_order_how.description: Second help line of the Tag order card, also read by screen readers on each handle: the three ways to move a tag. Space, Enter, Escape and the arrow keys are key names; use the names your keyboards print.

options_order_handle.description: Screen reader name of the grip handle at the start of a row in the Tag order card. $name$ is the tag's short chip word.

options_order_reset.description: Quiet text button under the Tag order list that puts the tags back in the default order.

options_order_reset_done.message: Las etiquetas vuelven al orden predeterminado.
options_order_reset_done.description: Screen reader announcement after Reset order saved the default order.

options_order_picked.description: Screen reader announcement when a person picks a tag up in the Tag order list, to move it. $name$ is the tag's chip word, $position$ its place and $count$ how many tags there are, as numbers.

options_order_moved.description: Screen reader announcement each time the picked up tag moves one place. $position$ is its new place and $count$ how many tags there are, as numbers.

options_order_dropped.description: Screen reader announcement when the picked up tag is put down and its new place is saved. $name$ is the tag's chip word, $position$ its place and $count$ how many tags there are, as numbers.

options_order_cancelled.description: Screen reader announcement when Escape puts the picked up tag back where it was. $name$ is the tag's chip word and $position$ its place, as a number.

options_color_help_short.message: No se comprueba el contraste. Consulta General.
options_color_help_short.description: Short help under a tag's color field. The full help is in the General tab (options_tab_general), which this names. It must say that contrast is not checked.

userscript_menu_settings.description: Entry in the script manager's menu (Tampermonkey, Violentmonkey) that opens the settings dialog on a store page. One word.

userscript_close.description: Button that closes the userscript settings dialog.

userscript_reload_note.message: Los cambios se aplicarán al recargar la página.
userscript_reload_note.description: Shown under the settings in the userscript dialog when the script manager cannot apply a change to other open store tabs at once.
